URL: https://docs.crustdata.com/api-reference/web-apis/web-fetch
Title: Web Fetch (Enrich Live)

Description: Fetch HTML content of webpages given their URLs. Retrieves page title and full HTML for up to 10 URLs in a single request. For content extraction, web content retrieval, data collection, content monitoring, and SEO analysis.

Rate limit: Default 15 requests per minute.

Method: POST
URL: https://api.crustdata.com/web/enrich/live

Auth: Bearer token (required)
Headers: x-api-version (enum, required, must be "2025-11-01")

Body (application/json):
  urls: string[] (required, 1..10 URLs, each max 2000 chars, must include http:// or https://)
  human_mode: boolean (default false) — bypass Cloudflare

Response (200): array of:
  success: boolean
  url: string | null
  timestamp: integer | null (Unix seconds)
  title: string | null (HTML <title>)
  content: string | null (full HTML)
Failed URLs have null fields but success=false.
